## Languages of the map page

The page's text is translated in `src/outputs/i18n/`. In `view.ts` every text a person reads goes through `tr("English text", { slot: value })` or, for a count, `trn(n, "{n} block", "{n} blocks")`: the English text is the key and the fallback, so a missing line shows English. Both take string literals only (`tests/i18n.test.mjs` reads them). To add a language: a file next to `it.ts` with its lines (a count takes plural forms by CLDR category, `other` required) and one entry in `LANGUAGES` in `i18n/index.ts`; the test says which lines are missing. Findings are translated too: `src/analysis/rules.ts` writes each from a template (`msg("… {slot} …", {…})`, see `src/analysis/message.ts`) and the page looks the template up in its language (`say`), so a new finding needs a line per language, which the same test checks. Raw compiler text, diagnostics and server errors stay English. The language is a per-browser choice (`localStorage`), not part of the map.
